body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage and make the target Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, it suffers -1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it voluntarily moves at least 2 units in one movement. Echo: deal 1 Necrotic Damage.
